task_title: Raise Go toolchain floor to 1.26.11 and align CI
task_criteria: go.mod declares go 1.26.11; every ci.yml setup-go pin is exactly 1.26.11; README prerequisite + tarball recipe at 1.26.11; release procedure documents the GOTOOLCHAIN pin; govulncheck ./... reports no vulnerabilities; bare make build links go1.26.11; make test green

items.criterion: go.mod declares go 1.26.11; every ci.yml setup-go pin is exactly 1.26.11; README prerequisite + tarball recipe at 1.26.11; release procedure documents the GOTOOLCHAIN pin; govulncheck ./... reports no vulnerabilities; bare make build links go1.26.11; make test green
items.detail: All seven sub-claims verified with fresh output. (1) go.mod:3 `go 1.26.11` (was `go 1.26.9` in commit b07ea135). (2) ci.yml has 4 setup-go steps (lines 26, 112, 151, 212); `grep -c setup-go` = 4 and `grep -c '1.26.11'` = 4 — matrix line 20 `go-version: ['1.26.11']` consumed at line 28, plus literal `'1.26.11'` at lines 114, 153, 214; the old floating `'1.26'` is gone. (3) README.md:426 `- Go **1.26.11+** — required to build`; README.md:437 tarball recipe `curl -fsSL https://go.dev/dl/go1.26.11.linux-amd64.tar.gz`. (4) GOTOOLCHAIN pin documented at README.md:451-456 (`GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.11 make release TAG=vX.Y.Z`, verify with `go version -m ./off-by-one | head -1`), Makefile:164-165, and CHANGELOG.md:37. (5) `govulncheck ./...` => `No vulnerabilities found.` GOVULN_EXIT=0. (6) `make build` rc 0; `go version -m ./off-by-one` => `./off-by-one: go1.26.11`. (7) `make test` => REAL_EXIT=0, 15 lines matching `^ok `, zero FAIL/panic (cmd/off-by-one, internal/{api,cron,export,graph,import,ingest,metrics,muster,sandbox,seed,solver,tools,web}, pkg/api all ok). `go vet ./...` also clean (VET_EXIT=0). [resolution 0.09; ci.yml]

items.criterion: No stale Go version pin remains in any live (non-historical) build/CI/doc surface — no ci.yml pin, Makefile, or README recipe still names a version below 1.26.11
items.detail: Only .github/workflows/ci.yml exists under .github (find .github -type f). All 4 setup-go steps pin 1.26.11; no `go-version` key anywhere else in .github. Makefile and README carry no sub-1.26.11 pin. Remaining `1.26.9`/`1.26.8` hits are historical records only: CHANGELOG.md:30,34 (describes the bump itself), CHANGELOG.md:63 (older release note), docs/qa/readme-8-reverification.md:81, docs/dogfood/2026-10-16-operator-integration.md:78-80, docs/dogfood/diagnostics.md:992-993, docs/dogfood/2026-09-22-integration.md:87, and skills/off-by-one-usage/SKILL.md:510 (a dated DF-48 finding entry describing the pre-fix state). None is a live build/CI pin.

items.criterion: The go.mod floor is the single source of truth: no `toolchain` directive overrides it, and GOTOOLCHAIN=auto resolves to go1.26.11 so a bare `make build` links 1.26.11 without env overrides
items.detail: go.mod:3 `go 1.26.11`; `grep -c '^toolchain' go.mod` = 0 (no overriding directive). `env -u GOTOOLCHAIN go env GOVERSION` => `go1.26.11`, proving auto-resolution reaches the floor toolchain with no env override. Bare `make build` rc 0 and `go version -m ./off-by-one` => `./off-by-one: go1.26.11`.

items.criterion: The documented GOTOOLCHAIN release pin is consistent with the go.mod floor, so the documented reproducible command actually selects the declared toolchain
items.detail: README.md:455 and Makefile:165 both document `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.11`, matching go.mod:3 `go 1.26.11` exactly — the documented reproducible release command selects the declared floor toolchain, not a different patch.

items.criterion: The README's factual claim that CI pins exactly 1.26.11 in every setup-go step is true of the actual ci.yml
items.detail: README.md:426 states 'CI pins exactly 1.26.11 in every `setup-go` step'. ci.yml has 4 setup-go steps (lines 26, 112, 151, 212) and all 4 resolve to 1.26.11 (matrix line 20 `['1.26.11']` consumed at line 28; literals at 114, 153, 214). Claim is factually accurate.
